scope: Tracked public concrete IReactor implementations under Semoss/src/prerna plus active ReactorFactory general and expression aliases. Project/classpath extensions are outside this catalog.

discovery.classGraphOrder: Fully qualified class name ascending; later registrations replace earlier mappings.

bytecodeTrace: ClassInfoList constructor invokes CollectionUtils.sortIfNotEmpty when sortByName is true.
ClassInfo.compareTo compares the full name fields with String.compareTo.

sourceDiscovery.method: Independent second JDK TreeScanner hierarchy traversal, separate from the catalog contract audit.

compiledFactoryMaps.method: Read ReactorFactory public registry maps through a URLClassLoader using the local compiled Semoss classes and deployed Monolith libraries; no reactors executed.
compiledFactoryMaps.purpose: Independent validation of names, aliases, dispatch contexts, and effective collision winners; does not claim full execution-contract equivalence.

implementationOutputTypes.method: TypeScript checker resolves ReactorCatalog[Name][output] for every name after all overlays; output-only type contracts are checked against the matching per-family producer evidence.

coverageSemantics: Base source-output counts retain the constructor/execution inventory baseline. Final counts resolve audited input contracts plus output-only implementation refinements. Known outer output includes the never type of a reactor with no successful return. Runtime-dependent payloads are separate from remaining unverified nested shapes; output audits do not imply verified input values.

Select.unverifiedVariant: Inherited named qs merging may return UpdateQueryStruct; use raw Pixel pending a subtype-aware audit.

Filter.unverifiedVariant: Inherited named qs merging may return UpdateQueryStruct; use raw Pixel pending a subtype-aware audit.

Join.unverifiedVariant: Inherited named qs merging may return UpdateQueryStruct; use raw Pixel pending a subtype-aware audit.

exclusions.reason: Prefix names enter metadata/reactors maps only; dispatch uses the unprefixed frame maps.

Calls to populateRFrameHash, populatePandasFrameHash, populateH2FrameHash, populateTinkerFrameHash, and populateNativeFrameHash are commented out. Commented historical general registrations are also excluded unless discovered independently.
GenericSelectorFunctionReactor accepts arbitrary function names under query-struct/selector parents; this is not a finite built-in registry.
Configured extra classpath packages and insight/project reactor overrides depend on deployment/project state and are outside the tracked prerna built-in snapshot.
Expression dispatch is case-insensitive. The finite catalog lists registered uppercase keys, conventional spellings, and concrete class names; arbitrary case permutations are not separate contracts.
